concerns.label: Agent Registry
concerns.governs: Master list of all agents, their RAG docs, load order, and operational prompt template
concerns.bounded_evidence_note: Adding or removing an agent requires updating the registry table, AGENT-MATCH routing rules, and verifying the RAG doc exists
concerns.rollback_evidence_note: Revert the AGENTS.md entry and confirm AGENT-MATCH no longer routes to the removed agent

concerns.label: Agent Routing Rules
concerns.governs: Domain-based routing rules that select which agent(s) handle a given task
concerns.bounded_evidence_note: New routing rules must reference agents that exist in the agent registry and have valid RAG docs
concerns.rollback_evidence_note: Revert the routing rule and verify no orphaned agent references remain

concerns.label: Agent Runtime Configuration
concerns.governs: Runtime configuration for agent LLM parameters, retry policies, and feature flags
concerns.bounded_evidence_note: Config changes must be validated by TypeScript compiler and tested against agent integration tests
concerns.rollback_evidence_note: Revert the config file and redeploy affected agent ECS services

concerns.label: Tool Gateway Policies
concerns.governs: Per-agent least-privilege tool access policies, domain allowlists, PII redaction, rate limits
concerns.bounded_evidence_note: Policy changes must preserve least-privilege invariant; changes require TypeScript compilation and agent integration test pass
concerns.rollback_evidence_note: Revert the tool-gateway.ts file and redeploy the agent orchestrator service

concerns.label: Module Catalog
concerns.governs: Registry of non-quote signal modules with legal basis, policy profiles, and payload schemas
concerns.bounded_evidence_note: New modules require legal basis classification, ToS review, policy profile, payload schema, contract tests, and canary rollout evidence
concerns.rollback_evidence_note: Remove the module entry and verify no downstream consumers reference it

concerns.label: Reason Code Catalog
concerns.governs: Canonical set of reason codes used in evidence results, run artifacts, and alert evaluations
concerns.bounded_evidence_note: New reason codes must follow the naming pattern, have valid severity and domain, and be referenced in at least one evidence script or run artifact
concerns.rollback_evidence_note: Remove the reason code entry and verify no evidence scripts or run artifacts reference it

concerns.label: IssueOps Schema Contracts
concerns.governs: JSON Schema definitions for PRD, Plan, Run, Evidence, Skill, and other IssueOps artifacts
concerns.bounded_evidence_note: Schema changes must be backward-compatible or versioned; all existing artifacts must still validate against the updated schema
concerns.rollback_evidence_note: Revert schema files and verify all IssueOps artifacts still validate

concerns.label: Observation Payload Types
concerns.governs: TypeScript type definitions for observation envelopes consumed by the triangulation engine and signal modules
concerns.bounded_evidence_note: Payload type changes must preserve backward compatibility with existing silver.observation records; TypeScript compiler must pass
concerns.rollback_evidence_note: Revert the type definitions and verify all consumers compile cleanly

concerns.label: Failure Bundle Types
concerns.governs: TypeScript type definitions for failure bundles exchanged between agents during self-healing workflows
concerns.bounded_evidence_note: Type changes must be compatible with all agent consumers; TypeScript compiler must pass across plane-b and shared
concerns.rollback_evidence_note: Revert the type definitions and verify all agent consumers compile cleanly

concerns.label: System Invariants
concerns.governs: Must-not-break rules for plane boundaries, data integrity, index semantics, agent scoping, and security
concerns.bounded_evidence_note: Invariant changes require architectural review and must be reflected in all derived SPECS copies
concerns.rollback_evidence_note: Revert ARCHITECTURE.md and verify SPECS/architecture.md is also reverted

concerns.label: Skills Catalog
concerns.governs: Registry of IssueOps skills with their workflow bindings, input schemas, and execution modes
concerns.bounded_evidence_note: New skills require a matching workflow file, valid input schema, and catalog entry with correct skill_id format
concerns.rollback_evidence_note: Remove the skill entry and verify no workflows or brain routing rules reference the removed skill

concerns.label: Deploy Promotion Checklist
concerns.governs: Step-by-step checklist for promoting agent changes from dev to staging to prod
concerns.bounded_evidence_note: Checklist changes must be validated against current deploy pipeline and reflected in SPECS bundle
concerns.rollback_evidence_note: Revert the checklist and verify SPECS copy is also reverted

concerns.label: Operational Runbooks
concerns.governs: Human-facing runbooks for incident response, provider outages, queue debugging, and operational procedures
concerns.bounded_evidence_note: Runbook changes should be reviewed by on-call engineers and tested against current infrastructure
concerns.rollback_evidence_note: Revert the runbook and notify on-call team of the change

concerns.label: Priority and Run-Order Policy
concerns.governs: Task sort algorithm (dependency_depth > priority > run_order > id), single in_progress constraint, and default values (priority=100, run_order=array index)
concerns.bounded_evidence_note: Changes to sort algorithm or single-threaded execution model require evidence that all existing PRD items are still scheduled in correct order
concerns.rollback_evidence_note: Revert compareTaskOrder function in scripts/ralph/plan.mjs and rebuild IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md to restore previous ordering

concerns.label: Tag Versioning Conventions
concerns.governs: Versioned tag namespaces (owner.*, trace.*, parallel.*, cluster.*, gate.*, snapshot.*, ops.*) and their immutability contract; all tags follow pattern [a-z0-9._:+-]+@v[0-9]+
concerns.bounded_evidence_note: New tag namespaces or version bumps must be documented in .remit-scout/AGENTS.md and validated by CI; all traceability_tags must include bounded_evidence and rollback_evidence markers
concerns.rollback_evidence_note: Revert tag convention changes in .remit-scout/AGENTS.md and verify all existing artifacts still use valid tag versions

concerns.label: Ralph Plan Version Pins
concerns.governs: Pinned version constants for ralph loop protocol (v2), plan schema (v2), progress schema (v1), and task lifecycle (v1); any version bump must be backward-compatible or migration-gated
concerns.bounded_evidence_note: Version bumps require migration evidence showing all existing progress.txt and IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md files remain parseable; task lifecycle version bumps must document new transition rules
concerns.rollback_evidence_note: Revert the version constants in scripts/ralph/plan.mjs and verify existing plan/progress artifacts still parse correctly

concerns.label: Progress State Semantics
concerns.governs: Dual-write atomicity (plan + progress), idempotent same-state writes, note merging deduplication, single in_progress constraint, and reconcile-progress recovery behavior
concerns.bounded_evidence_note: Changes to idempotency or dual-write behavior require evidence that existing progress.txt files remain parseable and no state is lost during reconciliation
concerns.rollback_evidence_note: Revert mark/reconcileProgress functions in scripts/ralph/plan.mjs and verify progress.txt is consistent with IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md

concerns.label: Ralph Orchestrator Config
concerns.governs: Project-level ralph orchestrator settings: CLI backend, event loop parameters, hat definitions (refactorer, verifier), and verification quality gates
concerns.bounded_evidence_note: Config changes must preserve hat contract stability; verifier hat must always require quality.* keys in emitted payloads
concerns.rollback_evidence_note: Revert ralph.yml and verify orchestrator loop still operates with previous settings
